business_summary.text: Dhoot Transmission is an auto components maker supplying wiring harnesses and non-wiring harness products such as battery packs, controllers, sensors and switches, primarily to two-wheeler OEMs.

guidance.statement: Confident of delivering 25-30% revenue growth for FY27.
EBITDA margin guidance of 15-16% for the full year.
Expects EV revenue share to exceed 30-32% in 2-3 years.
Multilink to grow 25-30% with margins in line with Dhoot.

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Automobile and Auto Components > Auto Components > Auto Components & Equipments

operating_notes.text: Copper accounts for about 20-23% of BOM cost, and price pass-through to customers lags by three months.
Wiring harness content per EV is 1.5-2.5x that of ICE, and up to 4x if all products are adopted.
Dhoot Autocomponents, a subsidiary, does about ₹1,200 Cr of business for group companies, which is self-consumption and not reflected in overall sales.
Subscribed to 250,000 shares of €1 each in Dhoot Transmission GmbH for ₹2.82 Cr.

timeline.summary: On its first post-listing earnings call, Dhoot Transmission guided FY27 revenue growth of 25-30% and a 15-16% EBITDA margin, after Q1 revenue rose nearly 50% YoY with EV at 27% of sales.
Dhoot Transmission subscribed to 2,50,000 shares in its German wholly owned subsidiary for ₹2.82 Cr.

watchlist.response: Management declined to give an exact breakup, citing customer concentration with a single customer.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the breakup of non-wiring hardware revenue by product (sensors, controllers, battery packs).

watchlist.response: Management denied losing market share and said it would reconcile the numbers separately; later stated ICE revenue grew 52.6%.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked whether the company is losing ICE market share, given ICE volumes grew 70% while the company grew 17%.

watchlist.response: Management declined to disclose, citing a confidentiality agreement with the single customer.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the value addition percentage in the battery pack business.

watchlist.response: Management said it depends on features and declined to comment, offering to connect the analyst with the CEO separately.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the cost impact of ADAS on an entry-level two-wheeler.
